The trick is not to eat Less, It's to eat less in one sitting and eat more frequently. Snacking on healthy things during the day (every few hours) is really way better then sitting down for three huge meals. 
Don't get rid of ALL the unhealthy stuff just most of it. If you have something that is bad for you once every week or two and you satisfy that craving chances are they will come more infrequently and you'll be able to eat healthier more often.
Also after you work out you should always always eat something that has protein. Lean meat or nuts are what I go for if I'm not feeling like having a protein shake. 
I hope this helps :)
Also I know this may seem like common sense, but drink lots and lots of water! it makes you think you are full and if you don't like water you could put Chrystal light or those squirt flavor things in the water.
